fair-haired = having light-coloured hair
curly hair = hair that forms curls, not straight
freckles = small brown spots on the skin, often on the face
beard = hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
slim = thin in an attractive, healthy way
overweight = heavier than is healthy or expected
middle-aged = neither young nor old, often about 40–60
teenager = a person aged about 13 to 19
twins = two children born to the same mother at the same time
outgoing = friendly and enjoying other people's company
shy = nervous about talking to people you do not know well
honest = always telling the truth and not cheating
reliable = someone you can trust to do what they promise
stubborn = not willing to change your mind
generous = happy to give time or money to others
jealous = unhappy because someone has something you want
embarrassed = feeling silly or uncomfortable in front of others
proud of = pleased with what you or someone else has done
get on with = to have a friendly relationship with someone
look like = to have a similar appearance to someone
